title: LAS CIGAL Convention Center
filmLabel: Celebrate in Style · LAS CIGAL film
intro: LAS CIGAL Convention Center is a modern event venue built for weddings, conferences and large celebrations, with a grand entrance, landscaped grounds and a spacious main hall.
Inside, the Majestic Hall seats a large gathering in comfort, with a raised stage, modern lighting and easy access — and outside, parking for 300 to 400 cars keeps arrival simple for every guest.

highlights.title: Majestic Hall
highlights.body: Large air-conditioned hall with rows of seating, a central carpet aisle and a raised stage.

highlights.title: Grand entrance
highlights.body: Covered portico and wide paved forecourt for easy guest arrival and photographs.

highlights.title: 300–400 car parking
highlights.body: Large paved parking grounds shown in the aerial views, with a dedicated parking entrance.

highlights.title: Chocoberry Cakes & Bakes
highlights.body: In-house cakes and bakes outlet at the front of the building.

highlights.title: Day and night presence
highlights.body: The building is fully lit at night, with illuminated signage visible from the road and from the air.
